text: Oh, absolutely. Because nothing says "Greek Statue" like the sheer, unadulterated laziness of shaking a piece of plastic until your wrist feels like it’s been used as a doorstop. Why bother with the archaic, inefficient concept of "sweat" or "muscle tension" when you can just achieve a physique that is 90% hope and 10% static electricity? It’s the fitness industry’s greatest magic trick: convincing you that if you just jiggle hard enough, your abs will materialize out of thin air, much like a miracle, or perhaps just a very aggressive case of the shakes. Who needs gravity when you have delusion?
